# DLSSync

> Open-source Windows 10/11 x64 desktop app built with Tauri v2, Svelte and Rust. Updates supported DLSS, FSR, XeSS, Streamline and DirectStorage DLLs already present in game folders; also offers GPU and Windows device-driver update workflows. Apache-2.0.

The repository version is 1.7.0, released for Windows 10/11 x64 and dated in CHANGELOG.md. Published availability and the signature state of a specific file must be checked on the download pages.

Integrity layers are distinct: Ed25519-signed catalog metadata, per-entry artifact hashes (SHA-256 or historical MD5), Authenticode publisher verification, and SHA-256-verified local backup snapshots. Catalog sources include first-party releases and labeled DLSS Swapper community-archive history. A correct hash does not prove game or hardware compatibility. Restore can fail if snapshots are missing, invalid or inaccessible.

Standard includes the app self-updater and allows automatic catalog refresh. NexusBuild- must have no self-updater, no automatic app-update or catalog calls, and only explicit manual network actions. Both v1.7.0 channels must use the same tag and source commit. The channel guide records current implementation and release-verification gaps; this index does not certify Nexus network silence. Portable mode stores state beside the executable and disables app self-update.

Nexus preparation writes derived configuration under `target/channels/nexus/config` without overwriting tracked configuration. Release publication refuses to delete an existing release. Standard `latest.json` must name only the exact Standard installer and include a nonempty matching signature. The AMD driver source opens an observed official AMD page instead of synthesizing an installer URL.
